channel.title: The Karnali Briefing
channel.description: Private feed for Johnny's Nepal shoot: the field brief, the Jaba card, and ten essays for the drive from Surkhet to Hilsa.
channel.itunes:author: Parley

item.title: A Letter Before the Road
item.description: From a teacher, the night before you drive. Listen to this one first.

item.title: The Field Brief
item.description: Your director's briefing for the Karnali shoot, read by George. Theme, Jaba, visual evidence, daily rules.

item.title: The Market Brief
item.description: What makes documentaries travel: Jiro to Free Solo to Bourdain, applied to The Human Element.

item.title: The Jaba Card
item.description: Two minutes. Replay before every visit with Jaba.

item.title: Film School I: The Machinery of Feeling
item.description: Kuleshov, the close-up, the empathy machine: how a screen gets inside a body.

item.title: Film School II: The Camera's Conscience
item.description: A hundred years of filmmakers fighting about what a documentary owes the truth.

item.title: Film School III: Time, the Only Material
item.description: Tarkovsky, Murch, and why feeling lives in duration and the cut.

item.title: Film School IV: The Face and the Voice
item.description: Falconetti to Marker: presence, narration, and earning a true face from a stranger.

item.title: The Road
item.description: Thirty-four years of a promise, told in dynamite, dust, and fresh asphalt.

item.title: The Crossroads
item.description: The oldest thing about Humla is not its remoteness but its traffic.

item.title: The Women Who Stay
item.description: The road that connects Karnali to the world carries its men away.

item.title: What the Road Means
item.description: On walking-time, driving-time, and what happens when a week becomes a day.

item.title: The Monastery
item.description: The institution that made remoteness livable meets the road that ends it.

item.title: The Border
item.description: Nepal's remotest district shares a footbridge with the world's most ambitious state.

item.title: The River
item.description: The last of Nepal's great rivers still runs free.

item.title: The Apples
item.description: In Nepal's most remote district, the price of an apple is the price of the road.

item.title: The Republic of the Young
item.description: Nepal's youth revolution, seen from the poorest province.

item.title: The Airstrip
item.description: A town built on flight learns what it means to be driven to.
